newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Audi working on second aluminium car.
newsitem.headline: Audi working on second aluminium car.

text.p: Volkswagen AG unit Audi will decide this year whether to make a second aluminium-body car, with production to start before the turn of the century, director Franz-Josef Paefgen said on Thursday.
"Production would definitely be before the year 2000, with deliveries possibly in 1999," Paefgen said during a visit to Swiss aluminium maker Alusuisse.
The new car would be smaller than Audi's A8 model, Paefgen said, adding that production technology was either already complete or under development.
No name has been decided for the new car, of which Audi hopes to sell at least 50,000 units annually.

Paefgen said earlier that Audi's business had developed satisfactorily in the first nine months of the year and the Ingolstadt-based German car producer was aiming for a profit "clearly better" than last year.
